title: Markets & Makers — Civic Buildings v1

style.rule: Compact, prosperous solarpunk civic architecture matching the official logo world and approved business turntables.

foundation_border.rule: Keep the thin dark perimeter visible around every 2 m surface card.

economy_rule: Civic buildings publish quota-limited demand and provide services. They never manufacture tradable output, buy resources without a cap, or become player-owned yield assets.

buildings.name: Sunspire City Hall
buildings.function: Mayor hub, policy, taxes and district projects
buildings.hero_cue: U-shaped council garden and amber solar-clock lantern

buildings.name: Sunvault Treasury & Reserve Desk
buildings.function: Civic budgets, quotas, monetary indicators and reward claims
buildings.hero_cue: Teal reserve drum and amber public sun-disc

buildings.name: Plot & Enterprise Registry
buildings.function: Plot leases, business licenses and construction permits
buildings.hero_cue: L-shaped map hall and plot-grid timber pergola

buildings.name: Tidegate Transit Hall
buildings.function: Ferries, regional markets, commuters and freight handoff
buildings.hero_cue: Long aqua arched hall with solar passenger canopy

buildings.name: Sunleaf Community Clinic
buildings.function: Citizen health, workforce recovery and civic supply demand
buildings.hero_cue: Aqua waiting conservatory, medicinal roof and rain tank

buildings.name: Tidewatch Rescue Station
buildings.hero_cue: Twin rescue bays, solar watch chimney and drone disc

buildings.name: Civic Works Depot
buildings.function: Road, bridge and utility maintenance contracts
buildings.hero_cue: Service hall, repair pergola, module racks and fixed gantry

buildings.name: Maker Academy & Library
buildings.function: Training, blueprints, specialization and creator onboarding
buildings.hero_cue: Two learning wings around a cylindrical aqua library

buildings.name: Garden Commons Residences
buildings.function: AI-citizen population, labor and household demand
buildings.hero_cue: Courtyard homes with timber galleries, solar roofs and gardens
